title: Dispatch: durable desc-mechanics numeric-conservation gate + schema robustness (attempt 1)
description:
PR #455 review finding batch C — runs AFTER batches A/B1/B2 merge (their fixes must land first or the new gate will correctly fail). Two parts:
1. Durable gate (importer test, e.g. packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/): numeric conservation between magic-item description prose and mechanics, both directions, covering base mechanics AND variants[*].mechanics: (a) forward — every dice token (NdM) and 'DC n' in a description must appear in that item's mechanics (dice normalized for spaces/minus-sign variants; DC accepted as dc/saveDc/'DC n' in strings) OR be covered by an explicit reviewed accept-list entry with a reason; seed the accept-list with: deck-of-many-things card dice (GM-mediated per reviewed disposition), figurine-of-wondrous-power 3d10 (lives in stat-block record), bead-of-force 1d4 found-count (loot metadata), ioun-stone 1d3 orbit distance (flavor), apparatus DC 20 only if batch B2 dispositioned it as adjudicated; (b) reverse — every dice token and numeric dc/saveDc in mechanics must appear in the description (same normalizations; accept-list for genuinely synthesized representations like deck-of-illusions 1d34 with documented reason). The deep audit deliberately excludes mechanics.* strings (isStrictProsePath), so this gate is the only defense for this class — that context belongs in the test header comment.
2. Engine schema robustness (packages/core/src/rules/magicItemMechanics.ts): forbid a stateMachine transition from declaring BOTH onFailure and effects (today the engine returns the transition's success effects on transitionOutcome:'failure'; no pack item combines them, so fail closed at schema validation until outcome-scoped effects are designed). Add a regression test in the engine suite.
Full verify:worktree; if part 1 finds NEW unexplained mismatches beyond the seeded accept-list, stop and report rather than accepting them.
notes:
